Alex — thanks for the time last week. Per our roadmap conversation, Flux Labs is coming up for renewal in July and you're evaluating a tier uplift across two product lines (Inference API and Dedicated Capacity).

Goal for this thread: align on stakeholders, confirm timelines for a revised SOW + pricing, and pick a QBR window to present the mutual action plan. High-level asks below: 

- Confirm internal Flux approvers and procurement timeline (PO vs. contract).
- Agree on target uplift (seats / vGPU pools / retention) so we can size Dedicated capacity.
- Schedule a 60-min QBR in late Apr/early May to review usage, uplift economics, and rollout phases.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Apr 11–18: internal Flux stakeholder sync + confirm uplift targets
- Apr 19–25: Redwood to deliver SOW v2 + pricing worksheet
- Apr 26–May 3: QBR presentation and commercial review
- May 4–18: Procurement/Legal review and final sign-off for July contract effective date

Attaching a usage export (Mar) and a draft SOW template for review. If the timeline looks tight on your side, flag the earliest blocker.

Next step: Alex — can you share the list of approvers and a procurement target date by EOD Wed (Apr 12)? I’ll coordinate the QBR poll and loop in our solutions lead (Marissa) and finance for pricing notes.

Thanks,
David

- Approvers: Me (Head of AI), Lina Chen (VP Engineering), and Mark Rodrigues (Head of Procurement). Procurement target: we’re aiming for a signed PO by June 15, legal review may take 2–3 weeks.
- Target uplift: want to move from the current Standard plan to Plus on Inference (roughly +2.5x token throughput) and add a Dedicated burst pool of 4 vGPUs for peak trading windows.

I’ll sync with Procurement on the precise PO timing and confirm by Wed EOD. Can you share a short one-pager on cost delta between Standard->Plus and the Dedicated pool? Also we prefer a QBR in the PDT morning (10–11am).
